adjudication.rationale: In `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/organizations/create.handler.ts`, the spread that sets `slug` was changed from `...(!IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED && { slug })` to `...(IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED ? { slug } : {})`, which inverts when `slug` is written. The adjacent `metadata` line still only sets `requestedSlug` when `IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED` is true, so with team billing enabled this now sets both `slug` and `requestedSlug` (bypassing the apparent “requestedSlug pending flow”), and with it disabled it sets neither (previously it set `slug`).
